title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild yourself from the remnants of fallen Titans.
pitch: As the core of a shattered Titan AI, you navigate a compact mech in a tactical arena, dismantling enemies to salvage vital components and unlock new abilities. Every choice affects your survival and identity, compelling you to rethink how you engage in combat.
coreLoop: Read attack patterns, evade or interrupt enemy strikes, target subsystems for strategic dismantling, and make crucial decisions about salvaged components.

mechanics.name: Read & Evade
mechanics.description: Identify enemy attack intents based on telegraphed movements and evade or interrupt their strikes in real-time.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Aim at specific enemy subsystems to dismantle them, affecting the battle's outcome and what loot can be salvaged.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Decision
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, choose to install a component, secure it for extraction, or dismantle it for repair value.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming and targeting
controls.mouse: Left click to interact and attack

difficulty.start: easy to understand enemy patterns, simple dodging mechanics
difficulty.progression: enemy attacks become more complex and require quicker reaction times
difficulty.peak: challenging yet fair mechanics that encourage strategic thinking and skillful dodges

winLose.win: Defeat the enemy and make a strategic decision about the salvaged component.
winLose.lose: Failing to evade or interrupt attacks leads to mech destruction.

juice.screenShake: upon a successful hit or dodging a significant enemy attack
juice.particles: when an enemy subsystem is dismantled or looted
juice.hitStop: when an attack connects with the mech
juice.flash: when a critical decision is made on salvaging components

scopeNotes: No procedural dungeons, economy/shop, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, crafting, narrative scenes, or save systems beyond engine defaults.

scoreEvents: score increases with each successful evasion, subsystem targeted, and enemy dismantled
